question: Can two independent signed preparations certify the pair generator with bounded endpoint errors?

objects.definition: Orthogonal harmonic representative of the oriented hub shell z

assumptions.definition: Unit simplex metric and standard oriented incidence

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: Isolate harmonic shell representative and calculate exterior weight

dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: Both states measured for each signed basis preparation

calculation_steps: Identify the signed two-state pair with calibrated initial and endpoint matrices
Bound the transition error using the smallest initial singular value
Apply the near-identity matrix-log Lipschitz bound

result.scope: Two-state LTI candidate and conditional induced 2-norm bounds

verification.method: Direct derivation and three numerical synthetic cases
verification.actual_result: PASS expected nominal, polarity and gain outcomes

counterexamples_and_failures: Outer-face damping couples to the harmonic representative.
limitations: Requires independently bounded endpoint uncertainties and verified LTI scope.
No physical trace or independently certified calibration was supplied.
next_discriminant: Bench the signed pair and collect timing loopback, basis shots, and held-out preparations.
